title: EO 14412: federal high value assets and high impact systems
scope: Federal HVAs and high impact systems (not National Security Systems). Covered contractors face a Dec 31, 2030 FIPS/PQC compliance date under the FAR rule the order directs. Everything the order doesn't address falls back to the NIST policy.

sources.name: Executive Order 14412, Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks (signed June 22, 2026)

rules.section: Sec. 2(g) (PQC defined), Sec. 2(k) (FIPS 203), Sec. 5(b) (PQC algorithms standardized by NIST)

rules.note: Sec. 4(b)(iii): transition digital signatures to PQC by Dec 31, 2031.
rules.section: Sec. 4(b)(iii): PQC for digital signatures by December 31, 2031

rules.note: Sec. 4(b)(iii): transition digital signatures to PQC by Dec 31, 2031.
rules.section: Sec. 4(b)(iii): PQC for digital signatures by December 31, 2031

rules.note: Sec. 4(b)(ii): transition key establishment to PQC by Dec 31, 2030. RSA and EC keys of unknown use are dated by the earlier deadline.
